groups.name: No emoji, exclamation marks or em dashes
groups.definition: Is the visible copy free of emoji, exclamation marks and em dashes?

groups.name: Exclamation marks in promotional copy
groups.definition: Does the copy use exclamation marks for an upbeat or enthusiastic tone?

groups.name: Title joined with em dash
groups.definition: Does the page title join its parts with an em dash?

groups.name: Title joined with en dash
groups.definition: Does the page title join its parts with an en dash?

groups.name: Title uses pipe separator
groups.definition: Does the page title or caption text use a pipe character as a separator?

groups.name: Title repeats H1 wording
groups.definition: Does the page title repeat the wording of the h1?

groups.name: Title is bare organization name
groups.definition: Is the page title just the organization name with no tagline?

groups.name: Truncated teaser text with ellipsis
groups.definition: Are card titles, teasers or excerpts cut off with a trailing ellipsis?

groups.name: Headings with trailing ellipsis
groups.definition: Do headings end with an ellipsis for an inviting tone?

groups.name: Links and CTAs end with arrow glyph
groups.definition: Do links or CTA labels end with an arrow glyph?

groups.name: Text-light, link-dense page
groups.definition: Is the page short on text, with few words and many links?

groups.name: Phone number repeated as contact point
groups.definition: Is the phone number repeated in several places as the main contact?

groups.name: Formal legal footer text
groups.definition: Does the footer include formal legal or administrative text such as addresses, company numbers, licences or disclaimers?

groups.name: Title Case headings
groups.definition: Are headings and names capitalised on every word?

groups.name: Machine-paraphrased wording
groups.definition: Does the text read as machine-paraphrased, with awkward synonym substitution?

groups.name: Informal first-person casual voice
groups.definition: Is the copy casual and written in the first person?

groups.name: Playful slogan wordplay in section titles
groups.definition: Do section titles play on the brand slogan with warm phrasing?

groups.name: Brand-voiced caps fragments, sustainability theme
groups.definition: Does the copy use caps headline fragments and repeat a sustainability theme?

groups.name: Plain direct notices
groups.definition: Are notices such as closures stated in plain direct sentences?

groups.name: Headings mismatch content
groups.definition: Do headings and product labels fail to match the content or imagery beneath them?

groups.name: Same posts repeated across sections
groups.definition: Do the same posts repeat across hero, grids and sidebar lists?

groups.name: Wordmark differs from document title
groups.definition: Is the wordmark truncated or misspelled relative to the document title?

groups.name: Generic repeated category badge
groups.definition: Do all cards in a section reuse the same generic category badge label?

groups.name: Concrete numeric facts in descriptions
groups.definition: Do descriptions include concrete numeric figures?

groups.name: Brand names repeated with registered marks
groups.definition: Are brand names repeated as logos and inline text with registered marks?

groups.name: Legal line with // separators
groups.definition: Does the legal line separate items with '//'?

groups.name: Bold personal sign-off
groups.definition: Does a first-person mission message end with a bold personal sign-off?

groups.name: Parenthetical variant markers
groups.definition: Are entries labeled with short parenthetical markers such as (m) and (f)?

groups.name: Lowercase task-phrase link lists
groups.definition: Are link lists short lowercase verb-led phrases with arrow image bullets and dashed dividers?

groups.name: Inline glossary-term links in summaries
groups.definition: Do summaries contain inline underlined links to glossary-style terms?

groups.name: Generic Click Here CTAs with pill buttons
groups.definition: Are CTAs labelled generically, such as 'Click Here', on orange or navy pill buttons?

groups.name: Outlet-prefixed news headlines
groups.definition: Are news headlines prefixed with an outlet name and pipe, possibly in another language?

groups.name: Legal disclaimers under forms
groups.definition: Does small-print legal text sit under forms?

groups.name: Consistent .95 charm pricing
groups.definition: Do all prices end in .95?

groups.name: Social cards with caps, hashtags, emoji
groups.definition: Do social-style cards use all-caps phrases, hashtags and emoji?

groups.name: Casual p.s. affiliate footer
groups.definition: Does the footer end with a casual 'p.s.' affiliate disclosure and a copyright line below a divider?

groups.name: Formal institutional hero copy
groups.definition: Is the hero copy formal, institutional language about the organization's role?

groups.name: Letter-spaced uppercase red subheading
groups.definition: Is the subheading letter-spaced uppercase in lighter red, followed by a centred keyword-rich paragraph?

groups.name: Placeholder zero metric values
groups.definition: Do listings show placeholder-like zero values for metrics?

groups.name: Sentence-case headings with eyebrow labels
groups.definition: Are section headings sentence-case value statements with separate one-word eyebrow labels?

groups.name: Verbatim long catalogue product names
groups.definition: Are long product names shown verbatim including size and variant strings?
